dedupe_keys.name: mod ti synthetic inflow dataset for the g1 wind farm control benchmark

description: Technical University of Munich researchers publish moderate-turbulence boundary-layer inflow for simulations of G1 wind turbines. The free Zenodo ZIP uses CC BY 4.0 and contains mesh coordinates plus text files of streamwise, lateral and vertical velocities at each saved time. A SOWFA tunnel simulation resolves the inlet spires and samples a plane 19.1 metres from the inlet. The sequence spans approximately seventy seconds at 0.9-millisecond intervals. These fields support controlled comparisons of wake and turbine-control simulations. Related G6 data-g1-wind-farm-high-turbulence-les-inflow provides the distinct high-turbulence case. Coverage is a synthetic tunnel-scale inflow, and full-scale application depends on an additional scaling procedure. It does not capture long-term site weather or every inflow regime. Numerical uncertainty and repeated use of short sequences require assessment. No fields were downloaded or solver run.
